question: Do the two hypoxemia event cells, deployed as the frozen static MIMIC model with online Platt scaling, pass the event gate on SICdb and HiRID in a retrospective observation-time replay?

prior_project_use.SICdb: scored once under v10 for continuous cells (44/47 robust, including o2sat@12h); current SpO2 and its history were model features there; the 1h/3h future SpO2 columns were never used as labels or viewed
prior_project_use.HiRID: as SICdb (36/38 robust under v10); third-party copy not verifiable against official checksums
prior_project_use.claim: a newly frozen binary-task evaluation on previously used external sites, not untouched databases

deployment_form: frozen static hypoxemia model (_fit_hypoxemia, 5 MIMIC samples) + online Platt scaling (Gupta & Ramdas 2023; gamma 0.1, rho 100, radius 100, start (1, 0)); each hospital its own deployment on the shared deployment clock; warm-up stays not scored

gate.point: Brier beats persistence (current SpO2 <= 92) and the OPS-recalibrated MIMIC-prevalence comparator: patient-level paired bootstrap upper bound < 0
gate.calibration: pooled point estimates CITL in [-0.2, 0.2] and slope in [0.8, 1.25] (research tolerances, not statistical equivalence); not identifiable or any invalid prediction = fail
gate.robust: full pass in >= 4 of 5 MIMIC samples
gate.diagnostics_not_gated: patient-cluster bootstrap intervals; calibration by hospital, care unit and stream phase

decision_rule: a cell robust on both SICdb and HiRID is an independently replicated event cell within the claim scope; robust on one = candidate.  Any registry change requires the user's approval.
claim_scope: retrospective observation-time replay (final values, label availability = anchor + h + |offset|; SICdb SpO2 is an hourly aggregate; HiRID patient = admission); pooled site-level calibration
post_hoc_decisions: calibration tolerances fixed after the static calibration check on eICU, NWICU and Emory
online Platt scaling adopted by amendment after the MIMIC-only rule selected static (4 vs 4 streams)
data-free Codex pre-freeze review: all 7 findings fixed (CODEX_REVIEW_EVENT_PREFREEZE_20261029.md)

development_reference_not_a_prediction.diagnostics: eICU first-third slope 0.75-0.86; about a third of estimable eICU hospitals outside the tolerances; single-site databases stable from the first third; care-unit CITL up to +/-0.66 (NWICU)

preconditions_before_any_label_is_read: lockbox_addendum.py --protocol <this file> --database <db> --files <extractor, its test, mapping file, the 1h and 3h extraction parquets and reports>: the parquets must be byte-identical to the previous protocol's addendum

evaluation.command: python site_adaptive_event_audit.py --database <SICdb|HiRID> --external-template <db>_observation_transitions_{horizon}h_v1.parquet --protocol <this file> --output site_adaptive_event_lockbox_<db>_v11.json (run from the project folder; every other option at its default)

one_shot_rule: each database is scored once (ledger step binary_<db>); the claim cannot be repeated, so a crash after the claim ends that database's evaluation unless the user decides otherwise, and is reported
refreeze_rule: if any hashed file changes before scoring, a new protocol version must be frozen before any label is read
